spec.headline: The 1.10 Threshold: Binary Risk Containment
spec.subhead: A position is either securely collateralized or isolated before undercollateralization spreads.

blocks.text:
HF > 1.10

HEALTHY POSITION

Priced account maintains active collateral buffer above threshold.

• Continuous buffer monitoring
• Full withdrawal and borrowing capacity
• Protected against liquidation protocols

HF ≤ 1.10

LIQUIDATION CANDIDATE

Eligible for liquidation subject to oracle, configuration, funding, and execution checks.

• Immediate collateral isolation activated
• Multi-gate protocol validation required
• Liquidator incentive bonus unlocked
Automated risk engines evaluate threshold solvency on every oracle tick before state mutations execute.

focal.reason: Draws immediate focus to the liquidation trigger condition and its multi-gate validation process.

spec.disclaimer: Threshold evaluations and execution checks occur deterministically across all active positions.

defects.issue: Collapsed typographic hierarchy and run-on inline copy in comparison columns
defects.reason: Metric values, status tags, descriptive paragraphs, and bullet points run directly into each other without line breaks or scale differentiation, creating an unreadable block of text.
defects.fix: Break each column into distinct vertical tiers: set 'HF ≤ 1.10' and 'HF > 1.10' as 24px semi-bold headers, separate status labels ('LIQUIDATION CANDIDATE' / 'HEALTHY POSITION') into 12px uppercase tags below with 8px margin, separate description into a discrete paragraph, and render each bullet item on its own line with 8px row gap.

defects.issue: Severe contrast failure on inactive column and footnote
defects.location: Left comparison block and bottom-most footnote text
defects.reason: Muted gray text falls well below accessible contrast thresholds against the near-black ground, rendering secondary information difficult to read.
defects.fix: Increase left column body color brightness to at least #8E8B99 (minimum 4.5:1 contrast) and raise footnote font size to 13px at #716E7F.

defects.issue: Unbalanced canvas weight and absent structural containers
defects.reason: The entire layout relies on unstructured raw text stacked along the left margin, leaving the right half visually empty and depriving the comparison of an institutional, structured feel.
defects.fix: Place both comparison states inside side-by-side card containers with subtle 1px border (#22202E) and balanced internal padding (24px) spanning an 880px total grid width.
